item_short_desc: Security and safety come first with the world’s best combination padlock: the MasterLock Combination Lock. Featuring a dial combination for keyless convenience, this lock includes a preset 3-digit combination with 1500 possible combinations for enhanced security. Constructed with a durable stainless-steel lock body, it offers superior strength and protection against theft. The hardened steel shackle adds extra cut resistance, ensuring your gear stays safe.
